verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe D1 (serverless SQL) as queryable directly from Workers with no connection management, backed by Wrangler CLI commands (`wrangler d1 create`) and binding-based access from Worker code, consistent with community mentions of using D1 as a database. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking/confirmation of connection-pooling behavior, and more detail on query API ergonomics beyond marketing copy.
